points.en: The Eight Core Sectors comprise 40.27% of the weight of items included in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).
points.hi: The Eight Core Sectors comprise 40.27% of the weight of items included in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP).

points.en: The sectors are: Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity.
points.hi: The sectors are: Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity.

points.en: Petroleum Refinery production has the highest weight among the eight sectors.
points.hi: Petroleum Refinery production has the highest weight among the eight sectors.

points.en: Fertilizers have the lowest weight among the eight sectors.
points.hi: Fertilizers have the lowest weight among the eight sectors.

points.en: Data is released by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
